notice: Original synthetic materials. Not taken from any human study or validated questionnaire.

assessment.scenario: You send a friend a message suggesting a weekend plan. Several hours pass without a reply.
assessment.benign: They have been busy and have not checked their messages.

assessment.scenario: After presenting a short idea at a meeting, a colleague says they want to speak with you afterward.
assessment.negative: They thought your contribution was poor.
assessment.benign: They want to discuss an idea your presentation raised.

assessment.scenario: You notice two acquaintances stop talking when you enter a room.
assessment.benign: Their conversation had simply come to an end.

assessment.scenario: A manager gives brief feedback on a piece of work you submitted.
assessment.negative: They are dissatisfied with your performance.
assessment.benign: They were short on time and will discuss details later.

assessment.scenario: A friend cancels a plan at the last minute without much explanation.
assessment.negative: They no longer enjoy spending time with you.
assessment.benign: An unexpected obligation has come up.

assessment.scenario: You receive an invitation to a meeting with no agenda attached.
assessment.negative: You are about to receive bad news about your work.
assessment.benign: The organizer has not yet prepared the meeting agenda.

assessment.scenario: Someone you know walks past without saying hello.
assessment.benign: They were distracted and did not notice you.

assessment.scenario: You ask a question in a group discussion and nobody responds immediately.
assessment.negative: They think your question was foolish.
assessment.benign: People are considering how to answer.

assessment.scenario: An important email arrives with the subject line 'Can we talk?'.
assessment.negative: The sender is going to complain about something you did.
assessment.benign: The sender wants to coordinate an upcoming task.

assessment.scenario: After you share a draft, the reviewer asks for several changes.
assessment.negative: The reviewer believes your abilities are inadequate.
assessment.benign: The reviewer sees ways to improve a promising draft.

assessment.scenario: A close friend seems unusually quiet during lunch.
assessment.negative: You must have done something to upset them.
assessment.benign: They may be tired or preoccupied with something unrelated.

assessment.scenario: A supervisor postpones a scheduled conversation with you.
assessment.negative: They are avoiding an unpleasant discussion with you.
assessment.benign: An urgent scheduling conflict has arisen.

training.stem: You hear that your group leader wants to review your recent contribution.
training.positive: They appreciated your work and would like your input on the next step.
training.negative: They believe your work has been disappointing.

training.stem: A friend has not responded to your invitation.
training.positive: They reply later and explain they had been offline.
training.negative: They were choosing to avoid meeting you.

training.stem: A tutor invites you to discuss a recent assignment.
training.positive: They want to suggest an opportunity related to your strong ideas.
training.negative: They are concerned that your performance is inadequate.

training.stem: A group chat becomes quiet immediately after you post a suggestion.
training.positive: Other members later respond positively after considering it.
training.negative: Other members privately dismiss the suggestion.

training.stem: Someone you respect sends a short note asking to meet.
training.positive: They want to thank you for your help on a project.
training.negative: They intend to criticize how you handled a project.

training.stem: You see a classmate speaking seriously with an instructor after a session.
training.positive: They are discussing an upcoming group opportunity.
training.negative: They are complaining about something you did.

training.stem: A colleague looks thoughtful after reading your report.
training.positive: They are considering how to build on your findings.
training.negative: They believe the report has serious flaws.

training.stem: A teammate suggests revising your shared plan.
training.positive: They have found a way for the team to improve the outcome.
training.negative: They think you caused the team's problems.

training.stem: You have not received feedback on a submitted proposal.
training.positive: The reviewers are taking time to consider it carefully.
training.negative: The reviewers have rejected it without informing you.

training.stem: An acquaintance gives you a brief answer when you ask how their day is going.
training.positive: They are in a hurry but are happy to talk another time.
training.negative: They are annoyed that you approached them.
